fold: A dispute over grazing rights and water access has run for # seasons, and the families on each side no longer speak to # another.
text: A dispute over grazing rights and water access has run for two seasons, and the families on each side no longer speak to one another.
why: a grazing/water dispute not in QUARRELS (none), TENSIONS (succession only), CRISIS or PAST; and 'no longer speak' contradicts Stable
